# Temporal Decay in Episodic Memory

Episodic memory weakens over time when not reinforced. The decay curve is
roughly exponential — recent items remain accessible, distant items fade
unless rehearsed or linked to other accessible items.

## Mechanism

Hippocampal traces consolidate into cortical representations during sleep.
Without reactivation, the trace becomes harder to retrieve as competing
memories accumulate.

## Implications for Personal Knowledge Bases

A vault that doesn't periodically re-surface old material will functionally
forget it. Periodic review (spaced repetition, linkbacks from new ingests)
keeps the graph traversable.
